mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.yonghu_id as yonghuId ,a.gongjiaoxianlu_id as gongjiaoxianluId ,a.zhandian_name as zhandianName ,a.dingyue_status as dingyueStatus ,a.tixing_status as tixingStatus ,a.tixing_content as tixingContent ,a.create_time as createTime ,a.update_time as updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
-- 级联表的字段 ,yonghu.yonghu_name as yonghuName ,yonghu.yonghu_phone as yonghuPhone ,gongjiaoxianlu.gongjiaoxianlu_name as gongjiaoxianluName ,gongjiaoxianlu.gongjiaoxianlu_types as gongjiaoxianluTypes
FROM daozhandingyue a left JOIN yonghu yonghu ON a.yonghu_id = yonghu.id left JOIN gongjiaoxianlu gongjiaoxianlu ON a.gongjiaoxianlu_id = gongjiaoxianlu.id
and a.id in
#{item}
and ( a.yonghu_id = #{params.yonghuId} )
and ( a.gongjiaoxianlu_id = #{params.gongjiaoxianluId} )
and a.zhandian_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.zhandianName},'%')
and a.dingyue_status = #{params.dingyueStatus}
and a.tixing_status = #{params.tixingStatus}
and a.tixing_content like CONCAT('%',#{params.tixingContent},'%')
and a.yonghu_id IS NOT NULL
and yonghu.yonghu_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.yonghuName},'%')
and a.gongjiaoxianlu_id IS NOT NULL
and gongjiaoxianlu.gongjiaoxianlu_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.gongjiaoxianluName},'%')
and gongjiaoxianlu.gongjiaoxianlu_types = #{params.gongjiaoxianluTypes}
order by a.${params.orderBy} desc
